title: Disappointed
body: Have been using this app for years and suddenly it’s no longer possible to increase the interval for a daily goal (e. 3x a day). What’s going on? :(
author: justareviewer77

title: Highly recommended!!
body: It’s so simple to use and straightforward. The layout also makes it easy to see the frequency of activities. I really love this app. It’s less complicated compared to other apps with too many features. Thank you so much!
author: Raraviel
